Kiez Coins ist eine kostenlose Testversi: Kiez Coins is a free test version. The terms of use for the test phase apply.
Hier steht, welche Daten Kiez Coins vera: This explains which data Kiez Coins processes, for what purpose and for how long. Kiez Coins uses no advertising, no tracking and no analytics tools.
Für das Konto speichern wir Deine E-Mail: For the account we store your email address and, if you set one, your password as an encrypted hash. Logging in with a code sends you a one-time code by email. The session stays stored on your device so you remain logged in.
Rechtsgrundlage ist die Erfüllung des Nu: The legal basis is the performance of the user agreement (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Wir speichern Deinen Decknamen, Dein Pro: We store your alias, profile picture, form of address, neighbourhood (as text, for example “Prenzlauer Berg, 10435 Berlin”), your settings and the times you agreed to these terms.
Zu Challenges speichern wir Titel, Text,: For challenges we store title, text, photos, place as text, deadline, coins, status and a point rounded to about 100 metres. Plus comments, likes, private operation names and groups including membership.
Andere angemeldete Personen sehen Deinen: Other logged-in people see your alias, profile picture, neighbourhood, challenges and comments. Challenges in groups are only seen by group members. Photos are stored at a public address. Anyone who knows this address can open the photo without an account.
Dein Standort bleibt auf Deinem Gerät: Your location stays on your device
Gibst Du den Standort frei, ermittelt De: If you share your location, your phone works out the district, postcode and street from it. It uses the operating system’s location service (Apple on iPhone, Google on Android). Kiez Coins doesn’t store your exact location. Only the neighbourhood as text and, for challenges, the rounded point are stored. Your phone calculates distances in the feed itself.
In der Web-App fragt Dein Browser Kiez u: In the web app your browser asks OpenStreetMap for neighbourhood and street (Nominatim service of the OpenStreetMap Foundation, United Kingdom). For this it only sends the point rounded to about 100 metres and, for technical reasons, your IP address. The basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR) and the EU adequacy decision for the United Kingdom.
Die Freigabe ist freiwillig und lässt si: Sharing is voluntary and can be withdrawn at any time in your phone’s or browser’s settings. Without sharing you enter your neighbourhood by hand.
Kontoinhaberin oder Kontoinhaber, IBAN u: We only store the account holder, IBAN and PayPal address if you enter them. They are private. For coins you share them with exactly the person who pays you the coins. Kiez Coins doesn’t process payments.
Meldest Du eine Person oder Challenge od: If you report a person or challenge or write to support, we store your message in order to handle it. The reported person doesn’t find out who reported. If you block a person, we store whom you blocked. If you give praise, we store whom you praised. Others only see the count, not who praised. To protect against abuse, our hosting service keeps technical logs with IP address and time for a short period.
Rechtsgrundlage ist unser berechtigtes I: The legal basis is our legitimate interest in safe, fair operation (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) and handling reports under the Digital Services Act (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR).
Diese Dienste verarbeiten Daten in unser: These services process data on our behalf
Supabase Inc. hostet Datenbank, Anmeldun: Supabase Inc. hosts database, login and photos. The servers are in the EU (Paris, France). EU standard contractual clauses apply to possible access from the USA.
Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, Paris, Frankreich: Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, Paris, France) sends the emails with login codes. For this Brevo receives your email address and the code.
Vercel Inc. (USA) liefert die Download-S: Vercel Inc. (USA) delivers the download page and the web app and processes your IP address for this. The basis is the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and EU standard contractual clauses.
Mit diesen Diensten besteht ein Vertrag: A data processing agreement under Art. 28 GDPR is in place with these services.

People aged 18 and over may take part. Each person has one account and keeps their login details secret. The email address must belong to you and be reachable.
Es gelten die Community-Regeln. Du stell: The community rules apply. You only post challenges, photos and comments you’re allowed to post. Illegal, insulting, discriminatory or dangerous content, advertising, spam and photos of people without their explicit consent are prohibited.

The money flows directly by bank transfer or PayPal. Cash payments and meetings for payment are not intended.

Über die Fahne an Challenges und Komment: Via the flag on challenges and comments, via “Report person” or by email you report violations and illegal content. We give reasons for such decisions by email. You can object to them by email.
Wir haften unbeschränkt für Vorsatz und: We are liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence and for injury to life, body and health. Otherwise we are not liable for the free test operation. People involved are liable for arrangements, tasks and payments between users.
Du kannst Dein Konto jederzeit unter „De: You can delete your account at any time under “Your account”. We can end the test phase at any time and will announce this beforehand by email.
